about.title: WHO IS YAKUMA?
about.body: Yakuma is a modern product studio building precise digital experiences for software, games, and interactive brands. We combine engineering discipline with visual direction, turning ideas into polished products that feel premium from the first interaction.

featured.title: Hoshi: Star Sudoku
featured.description: A calm Sudoku app built for daily focus, clear puzzles, and a polished mobile experience with Guided Hints, Training Mode, Stats, and Custom Themes customization for personal play.

faq.title: COMMON QUESTIONS
faq.intro: About the studio, what we build and how to reach us.

items.question: Who is Yakuma?
items.answer: Yakuma is a digital product studio founded by Yassin Kuczma. We build software, mobile apps, games and interactive experiences.

items.question: What is Yakuma developing?
items.answer: Yakuma is developing Hoshi: Star Sudoku, a Sudoku game on a star-shaped board. We also explore app concepts, backend systems, game ideas and product interfaces.

items.question: Who founded Yakuma?
items.answer: Yakuma was founded by Yassin Kuczma. His work brings together software engineering, product thinking, visual design and interactive experiences.

items.question: What services does Yakuma offer?
items.answer: Yakuma offers software engineering, Flutter apps, backend development, game design, product design and interface design, from concepts and prototypes to implementation and iteration.

items.question: How can I contact Yakuma?
items.answer: Email mail@yakuma.de or use the contact form. Tell us what you want to build, where the project stands and which platforms you have in mind.
